hook_text: Your whole life fits in a tiny piece of this rope. Who is at the very far end?
clip_script: Graaff-Reinet. A long rope across the school hall, with a card that says Today. Along it: birthdays, 1994, the founding of the town. Then all the way at the far end, a hunter with a bow. That is the San, hunter-gatherers who lived in southern Africa for tens of thousands of years. Much later, about two thousand years ago, came the Khoikhoi, herders of sheep and cattle. History is the study of the past, using clues called sources.
visual_style: Whiteboard timeline rope stretching far across the screen, with cards pegged on it and a hunter drawn at the very end.
mood: Curious and amazed, like discovering how old the world really is.
pacing: Quick pegs near Today, then a long, slow walk down the rope to the past.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and make a timeline of your own family.
